preservedResponsibilities: Defined normal non-mailmerge name lookup,localized copy-template,next-offset cache and signed32 exhaustion behavior. Actual mark ownership and cache belong to the caller;mailmerge naming,unique-name guards and full MarkManager behavior remain unported.
omittedResponsibilities: Complete native bookmark model,mailmerge,platform widgets and localization services remain unported or unverified.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The deterministic normal name-allocation loop is split from actual mark lifetime and document notifications in docbm.ts. The real mark manager retains its lookup and native offset cache; this value-only source responsibility can be verified directly at native counter boundaries without allocating billions of document marks.
